<thought>We have obtained the test set evaluation metrics (mae, rmse, r2, feature_importance) from the evaluate_xgboost_model tool. Next, we need to perform 5‑fold cross‑validation on the training data to get the mean and standard deviation of the R² score. The training CSV path is provided in the metadata. After obtaining both results, we will combine them into a JSON object with keys `test_set_evaluation` and `cross_validation_results`, then write this JSON to a file in the designated output directory and return its path.</thought>
